definitions.gloss: rice paddy; paddy field; wet-rice field
definitions.explanation: A flooded field used for cultivating rice. The defining feature is that the field is intentionally filled with water during the growing season. A central element of Japanese rural landscapes.

examples.english: To fill the rice paddies with water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車窓|しゃそう}→車窓：15504_shasou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な{水田|すいでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Vast rice paddies were visible from the train window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水田|すいでん}⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近代化|きんだいか}→近代化：15055_kindaika⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}→減少：02719_genshou⟧し⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The area of rice paddies in Japan has been continuously decreasing with the modernization of agriculture.

notes:
USAGE:
{水田|すいでん} is the formal/written term for rice paddies. The everyday word is ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧ (rice paddy). {水田|すいでん} is used in news, academic, and agricultural contexts. It contrasts with ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧ (dry field) and ⟦{田畑|たはた}→田畑：13527_tahata⟧ (fields in general). The character {水|すい} (water) distinguishes it as a wet-cultivation field.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水田|すいでん}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧: rice paddy region
- {水田|すいでん}⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧: wet-rice agriculture
- {水田|すいでん}⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧: rice paddy area
- {水田|すいでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to flood the paddies
